description: Source code implementing Bluetooth AVDTP profile client and server methods, including endpoint discovery, configuration, capability retrieval, and state management.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth AVDTP client operations such as discovery, configuration, and capability retrieval.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth AVDTP server operations including endpoint listing, capability management, configuration, and state transitions.

classes.name: StreamEndPoint
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth AVDTP stream endpoint with configuration and capability data.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers available stream endpoints and retrieves their capabilities.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for a specific stream endpoint.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data for a specific stream endpoint.

methods.name: OnDiscover
methods.description: Handles endpoint discovery requests on the server side.

methods.name: OnGetCapabilities
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve basic capabilities of an endpoint.

methods.name: OnGetAllCapabilities
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve all capabilities of an endpoint.

methods.name: OnSetConfiguration
methods.description: Handles configuration setting requests from clients.

methods.name: OnOpen
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state to OPENED.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles requests to change endpoint state to CONFIGURED.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles requests to start streaming (change state to STARTED).

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles requests to suspend streaming (change state to OPENED).

methods.name: OnAbort
methods.description: Handles requests to abort and reset endpoint to IDLE.
